PowerShell("=== Port 5000 listeners ==="; $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { foreach \($c in $conns\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "$\($c.LocalAddress\):$\($c.LocalPort\) PID=$\($c.OwningProcess\) Process=$\($proc.ProcessName\) StartTime=$\($proc.StartTime\)" } } else { "  \(nothing listening\)" }; ""; "=== All node.exe processes ==="; $procs = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($procs\) { $procs | Select-Object Id, StartTime, @{N='CmdLine';E={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-List } else { "  \(no node processes\)" })

PowerShell($processIds = @\(8068, 9104, 6000, 5508, 14420, 15520, 15364, 2016, 1352\); foreach \($processId in $processIds\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "Killed PID $processId" } catch { "PID $processId already gone or not killable: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($ports = @\(5000, 5173, 5174\); foreach \($p in $ports\) { $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($listener\) { "Port $p STILL OCCUPIED by PID $\($listener.OwningProcess\)" } else { "Port $p FREE" } }; ""; "=== Remaining node processes ==="; $procs = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($procs\) { $procs | Select-Object Id, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "  \(none — fully clean\)" })

PowerShell(node -e "const dns = require\('dns'\); console.log\('Node servers:', dns.getServers\(\)\); dns.resolveSrv\('_mongodb._tcp.shreegopalm.glbhxgi.mongodb.net', \(err, addrs\) => { if \(err\) { console.log\('System resolver FAILED:', err.code, err.message\); } else { console.log\('System resolver OK:', addrs.length, 'records'\); } const r = new dns.Resolver\(\); r.setServers\(['8.8.8.8', '8.8.4.4']\); r.resolveSrv\('_mongodb._tcp.shreegopalm.glbhxgi.mongodb.net', \(err2, addrs2\) => { if \(err2\) { console.log\('Google DNS via Node FAILED:', err2.code, err2.message\); } else { console.log\('Google DNS via Node OK:', addrs2.length, 'records'\); } }\); }\);")

PowerShell("=== Active network adapter DNS \(Windows side\) ==="; Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.ServerAddresses.Count -gt 0 } | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, ServerAddresses | Format-Table -AutoSize; ""; "=== Listening sockets on localhost:53 \(should be empty\) ==="; $l = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 53 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($l\) { $l | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "  \(none — confirms nothing for Node to talk to at 127.0.0.1:53\)" }; $u = Get-NetUDPEndpoint -LocalPort 53 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($u\) { "UDP listeners on :53:"; $u | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "  \(no UDP :53 either\)" })

PowerShell("=== Live node processes ==="; $procs = Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($procs\) { $procs | Select-Object Id, StartTime, @{N='CmdLine';E={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-List } else { "  \(none\)" }; ""; "=== Port 5000 ==="; $l = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($l\) { "OCCUPIED by PID $\($l.OwningProcess\)" } else { "FREE" })

PowerShell($s = node -e "console.log\(require\('crypto'\).randomBytes\(32\).toString\('hex'\)\)"; $path = "E:\\bill app\\backend\\.env"; $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes\($path\); $hasBOM = \($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF\); $content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText\($path\); if \($content -match '\(?m\)^TEST_BYPASS_SECRET='\) { Write-Error 'TEST_BYPASS_SECRET already present — refusing to clobber'; exit 1 }; $append = "`n# ── Test bypass secret \(development only — never set in production\) ──`n# Used by scripts/testE2E.js to bypass rate limits during regression testing.`nTEST_BYPASS_SECRET=$s`n"; $content = $content + $append; $enc = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new\($hasBOM\); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText\($path, $content, $enc\); "TEST_BYPASS_SECRET set, length=$\($s.Length\) hex chars, ends with: ...$\($s.Substring\($s.Length - 6\)\)")
